main_idea: GRPO raised Qwen3.8-27B's DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO lifted DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points
summary: A clear result chart is surrounded by a slogan headline, kicker lines, a dataset stats row, two method cards and a footer tagline that should go.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: Main result chart
regions.reason: Bars, values, axis, benchmark, metric and the +11.3 change annotation carry the finding.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: AfterQuery logo
regions.reason: Single brand mark at the top of the graphic.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Slogan headline
regions.reason: Generic slogan that does not state the measured finding; the chart title should carry it.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Series tag
regions.reason: Top-right kicker tag repeats the category and adds nothing to the result.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Eyebrow line
regions.reason: Kicker above the headline restating the topic and model.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Subtitle paragraph
regions.reason: Explains training set-up; the chart and footnote already cover it.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Dataset stats row
regions.reason: Dataset counts and training updates are a second point beside the main result.

regions.label: red
